description: Hand a shopping list to grocery delivery so the cook can order from a store near them. Pass the list_id returned by build_shopping_list or plan_meals, or pass recipes directly. Items marked as in the pantry are left off. Returns one link that opens the whole list when checkout is connected, otherwise a search link per item. When the cook's saved store is a Kroger banner (Kroger, King Soopers, and the other Kroger stores) and Kroger checkout is on, the list is added to their Kroger cart and the link opens that cart; if they haven't connected Kroger, ask them to open the connect link in the response (it is the one question that turn). Always share share_url with the cook: it's the one link that opens their order (a Befana link that sends them to the grocer's list, or Befana's order page with every item's store search). Optional provider picks the grocer (instacart, walmart, kroger, amazon or search); omit it and Befana uses the cook's saved store when that grocer is available, otherwise Instacart. Grocers are never ranked by commission. Befana does not choose brands or promote products; the cook picks the store and products and places the order themselves. When the reply includes commission_disclosure, say that sentence to the cook next to the link.

list_id.description: Id of a saved list from build_shopping_list or plan_meals

pantry.description: Ingredients the cook already has; they are not ordered

provider.description: Grocer to hand the list to: instacart, walmart, kroger, amazon or search. Omit for the cook's saved store, or Instacart when that store isn't available. An unknown or unavailable grocer returns an error listing the available ones.

units.description: US cups/oz/°F or metric grams/ml/°C. Defaults to the cook's setting.

name: order_groceries
title: Order the groceries for delivery
